## Coordination checklist

- [ ] I read the local `PROJECT_CONTROL.md` and `COORDINATION.md`.
- [ ] I verified live `main` rather than relying on a pinned ZIP or old handoff.
- [ ] I named any unmerged PR whose state this work relies on.
- [ ] If this changes current executable/research truth, I updated `PROJECT_CONTROL.md` and `coordination/control.json` or explained why no update is needed.
- [ ] If this invalidates or supersedes an old path, I named that path explicitly.
- [ ] If this affects the sibling repo, I recorded the cross-repo consequence instead of assuming another agent will infer it.
- [ ] I did not equate passing tests/citations/component success with product-level success.
